classification.difficultyReason: Find the scale factor from the matching widths, find B's height, then compute the area. Same structure as the earlier rectangle-area part, with decimals.

content.prompt:
These rectangles are similar.
Find the area of $B$.

answer.worked:
Let $w$ be the width of rectangle $B$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{w}{10}&=\frac{8.4}{14}\\w&=10\times\frac{8.4}{14}\\w&=6\text{ cm}\\\text{Area of }B&=8.4\times6\\&=50.4\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
